mapper.select: select ssp.name_code ,ssp.name , ssp.name_spell from standard_sport_market_sell ssms inner join standard_Sport_Team sst on sst.id in (ssms.team_home_id,ssms.team_away_id) INNER JOIN third_Team_Player_Relation as ttpr on ttpr.team_id=sst.third_team_id INNER JOIN standard_sport_player ssp on ssp.third_player_id =ttpr.player_id where ssms.match_info_id =#{matchId} and ssms.sport_id = #{thirdSportId}
